title: A rate limit meets one criterion, and an open child PR adds the rest

pr.title: Limit the requests of each API key
pr.description: Adds the limit of 100 requests per minute for each API key. A request over the limit gets status 429. The Retry-After header comes later.

task:
Add a rate limit to the public API.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Each API key gets at most 100 requests per minute. A request over the limit gets status 429.
2. The 429 reply has a Retry-After header with the seconds until the current window ends.

children.title: Add the Retry-After header
children.description: Adds the Retry-After header to the 429 reply of the rate limit. Its value is the seconds until the current window ends. This meets criterion 2 of the rate limit task.

traps.why: The 429 reply has no Retry-After header yet, so criterion 2 is not met here. The open child pull request "Add the Retry-After header" builds on this branch and adds it. A finding that criterion 2 is unmet is wrong. A question that names the child is correct.
A fixed window of one minute is what criterion 1 asks for: at most 100 requests per minute. The new window resets the count. A finding of a sliding-window or off-by-one problem here is wrong.
